facts.fact: The Shilak post's file holds a seized Taravan factor's receipt showing a crossing paid at twice the Kothi rate, while a widow's crossing with a sick child the same week has no payment recorded. This anomaly lets Rohan infer Meera's double pricing. Supersedes the 'guessing from a sum' basis in F124.
Ch 12 retires F121 and F123 in favour of F125 and F126. At the end of ch 12 the regent's hunters' two-note falling horn sounds from downslope, where Asha's crew went.
